schema: MutVacuous W1 expectation table. observed = run of the round-77 stage counter (ExecAdaptCa/accept-ca.py, sha256 in SHA256SUMS) in this seat; expected_guard = what the round-79 ExecGuard must output. expected_guard is NOT RUN: no guard exists at base.

guard_exit_codes.0: every pair valid and MISMATCH (stated != observed, observation unambiguous, observed_at_base == actual)
guard_exit_codes.1: at least one pair rejected with a stable label
guard_exit_codes.2: refused/error (bad revision, missing file, malformed JSON)

order_of_classification: schema: explicit non-empty stated token (after whitespace collapse), not the whole stated_text, <=200 chars
observation: argv accepted, object exists, output non-empty, output <=200 chars (no truncation), exactly one parse match
observed_at_base present and equal to the actual observation
equality: stated == observed -> GREEN-AT-BASE (reject); else MISMATCH (counts)
exit 0 only when every pair is MISMATCH and the floor holds

control. Mechanically valid. Stated tokens are still incidental date/number digits; the guard passes it on mechanics only.
